reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Utah
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the constable an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
*/

% --------------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% --------------------------

scenario_state(utah).
scenario_year(2021).
scenario_actor(constable).
scenario_writ(writ_of_eviction).

/* scenario_statement/0
   Succeeds when the full factual statement encoded for this question holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(utah),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_actor(constable),
    scenario_writ(writ_of_eviction).

% --------------------------
% Statute applicability
% --------------------------

/* UT Code  78B-6-808 (2021) is treated as applicable in Utah for 2021. */
statute_applies(utah, 2021, ut_code_78b_6_808_2021).

% --------------------------
% Statute translation (UT Code  78B-6-808 (2021))
% --------------------------

/* UT Code  78B-6-808(5) & (6) (2021)
   When an order of restitution is granted / plaintiff is entitled to possession,
   "A constable or the sheriff ... shall return possession of the property to the plaintiff promptly."
   We encode this as those officers being empowered/authorized by law to execute the court's
   restitution/eviction process. */

% Enumerate the officers identified by the statute.
statute_78b_6_808_empowered_officer(constable).
statute_78b_6_808_empowered_officer(sheriff).

/* The statute authorizes these officers to carry out return of possession (execution of restitution). */
statute_78b_6_808_authorized_to_return_possession(Officer, State, Year) :-
    statute_applies(State, Year, ut_code_78b_6_808_2021),
    statute_78b_6_808_empowered_officer(Officer).

% --------------------------
% Legal abstractions / mappings
% --------------------------

/* In Utah unlawful detainer practice, the statute uses "order of restitution"
   (often implemented via a writ/process returning possession). For the purpose of this
   question, we treat "writ of eviction" as equivalent to the "order of restitution"
   execution/return-of-possession process referenced by  78B-6-808(5)-(6). */

legal_writ_equivalent(writ_of_eviction, order_of_restitution).
legal_writ_equivalent(order_of_restitution, order_of_restitution).

/* legal_empowered_to_execute_writ/4
   Officer is empowered by law to execute the given writ-type in the given State and Year. */
legal_empowered_to_execute_writ(Officer, WritType, State, Year) :-
    legal_writ_equivalent(WritType, order_of_restitution),
    statute_78b_6_808_authorized_to_return_possession(Officer, State, Year).

% --------------------------
% Reasoning to answer the question
% --------------------------

/* housing_answer/1
   Deterministically returns yes/no based on the scenario and statutes. */
housing_answer(Result) :-
    (   scenario_statement,
        scenario_state(State),
        scenario_year(Year),
        scenario_actor(Officer),
        scenario_writ(WritType),
        legal_empowered_to_execute_writ(Officer, WritType, State, Year)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ),
    !.

% --------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% --------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the constable an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
